'''Shrokti''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] while a [[Battle of Ilum|battle]] that took place there. During the battle, Shrokti sold equipment from a stall in the [[Republic base camp]]. While at the stall, he wore a [[Color/Legends|brown]] and purple [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Shrokti had black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], no [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shrokti first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game he served as a Republic social items vendor on Ilum.
